home.intro: I'm a developer who builds web and mobile products with React, Next.js and React Native. Now I'm studying AI engineering — learning to build with language models and bring them into real products.

about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I'm a developer with over three years of professional experience in IT and systems maintenance. At Leader Group I looked after hardware, networking and databases for retail systems — both the cashier front line and the back office — across Leader Hypermarket, Leader Mart, Cement Timor, Auto Timor Leste and Lisun Timor.
about.paragraph2: Since 2025 I've been an IT Collaborator in the Software Development department at Viettel Timor (Telemor), one of Timor-Leste's leading telecommunications companies, building real applications used by staff and customers.
